findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.

evidence.snippet: $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Method Head -Uri https://automatedlab.org -TimeoutSec 5 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue  …  Start-Process -FilePath "C:\Program Files\Update Services\Tools\wsusutil.exe" -ArgumentList "postinstall", "SQL_INSTANCE_NAME=`"$SqlServerName`"", "CONTENT_DIR=`"$WsusContentPath`"" -Wait -ErrorAction "Stop"

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Install-LabOrchestrator2012' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
